facts.text: Trailer Park of Terror started life as an Imperium Comics series, then got boiled down from episodic comic stories into one linear night of terror.
Director Steven Goldmann made 200+ music videos, including six for Shania Twain, before this movie. Horror was a big swerve from country-video land.
Goldmann won country music's 'triple crown' for Faith Hill's 'This Kiss': CMA, ACM and CMT awards. Then he made a zombie trailer-park movie.
Trailer Park of Terror premiered at the Slamdance Film Festival in January 2008, then hit DVD on October 21, 2008.
Country star Trace Adkins made his film acting debut here as The Man.
Reported budget: about $3.25 million from independent investors, on a roughly 18-day shoot.
Principal photography reportedly took place in May 2007, with Santa Clarita, California among the listed filming locations.
The film nods to Herschell Gordon Lewis's Two Thousand Maniacs! (1964), Blacula (1972) and The Texas Chain Saw Massacre (1974).
One reviewer saw EC Comics, Herschell Gordon Lewis and John Waters in the film's backwoods slasher-comedy DNA.
Norma calls Bridget 'Dark Shadows', a nod to the gothic TV soap of the same name.
China Girl's cartoonish Chinese accent is an act. Her real voice is Southern like the other residents, a play on the racist expectations of her 'guests'.
The gun Norma gets from The Man is an M1 'enforcer' carbine pistol.
Alan Brewer scored the film with twangy country-western guitars, and also wrote and performed the song 'Demon Derby'.
Nichole Hiltz sings 'Come to Me, Satan' on the soundtrack. Robert Tepper, of 'No Easy Way Out' fame, performs 'The Darkest Day Has Come'.
Lew Temple (Marv) was also in The Devil's Rejects and The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning, so he's no stranger to horror.
Lew Temple and Fox News host Eric Bolling were fraternity brothers and teammates on the Rollins College baseball team.
Myk Watford (Roach) went on to No Country for Old Men and For All Mankind. He also sings 'Cry for the Camera' on this soundtrack.
Michelle Lee, who plays Miss China, later turned up in Black Widow, Bullet Train and Altered Carbon.
Joe Leydon of Variety said the film was well cast and that some young actors worked hard to flesh out their thin roles.
Horrornews.net compared Norma to 'Reese Witherspoon in Freeway' crossed with Sheri Moon Zombie in House of 1000 Corpses.
Fan-spotted goof: the spikes of the fence at the start of the film stick far out of Aaron's chest, but the fence has a crossbar that should have stopped them.
Frightfest 2008 promoted the film with a cast-and-costume PR tour. A screening was held on August 23 near London's Rose Playhouse site.
Matt King's 'Waiting at the Bottom' and 'Hell's Kitchen' are on the soundtrack, both produced by Jay Joyce.
Makeup effects designer Todd Tucker built the undead residents, with an emphasis on practical effects over CGI.
The film's tagline: 'Fear has a new home.'
Producers hoped the film would launch a franchise, TV series and comic line. It didn't.
